functional_requirements: Display grid of available themes (built-in + custom)
Show current theme selection with checkmark
Provide accent color picker (9 color options)
implementation_steps: Add theme grid section with thumbnails
api_contracts: Primary API surface is the AppearanceSettingsView.swift type and its public members.
Public APIs match Swift naming conventions and are documented in code comments.
ui_states: Hovering theme: Hover effect on thumbnail
ui_interactions: Drag glass slider → Update glass level
edge_cases: No custom themes - show only built-ins
Current theme deleted - fall back to Nebula
failure_modes: Theme apply fails - show error toast, keep previous theme
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
rollback_plan: Show minimal theme picker without glass/accent options
